title: Vacancy Circular for Section Officer, Private Secretary, Assistant, Account Assistant, Stenographer Grade I, and Upper Division Clerk on Deputation Basis
age_limit: The maximum age of the Applicant should not exceed 56 years on the closing date.
summary: Debts Recovery Appellate Tribunal (DRAT), Allahabad has issued a vacancy circular inviting applications for various Group-B and Group-C posts on deputation basis. Eligible candidates working under Central Government, State Governments, or Courts/Tribunals can apply through proper channel before the deadline of 28 December 2026.
eligibility_bullets: Section Officer: Officers under Central/State Government or Courts/Tribunals holding analogous posts on regular basis or with 5 years regular service in Level-6.
Private Secretary: Officers under Central/State Government or Courts/Tribunals holding analogous posts or with 5 years regular service in Stenographer Grade I in Level-6.
Assistant: Officers under Central/State Government or Courts/Tribunals holding analogous posts or with 10 years regular service in Level-4.
Account Assistant: Officers under Central Government holding analogous posts or with 10 years regular service in Level-4, and training in cash and account work.
Stenographer Grade I: Officers under Central/State Government or Courts/Tribunals holding analogous posts or with 10 years regular service in Level-4.
Upper Division Clerk: Officers under Central/State Government or Courts/Tribunals holding analogous posts or Lower Division Clerk with 8 years regular service in Level-2.

vacancy_breakdown.eligibility: Holding analogous post on a regular basis or 5 years regular service in Level-6.
Holding analogous post or 5 years regular service as Stenographer Grade I in Level-6.
Holding analogous post or 10 years regular service in Level-4.
Holding analogous post or 10 years regular service in Level-4 with training in cash and account work.
Holding analogous post or 10 years regular service in Level-4.
Holding analogous post or LDC with 8 years regular service in Level-2.

how_to_apply_steps: Ensure eligibility as per the prescribed criteria for the desired post.
Download the application format (Annexure-I & II) from the official circular.
Fill out the application completely and attach attested photocopies of APARs for the last 5 years.

Forward the application through proper channel to The Secretary/Registrar, Debts Recovery Appellate Tribunal, First Floor, E-10 B Building, BSNL Premises, Patrika Marg, Civil Lines, Prayagraj -211001 (U.P.).
Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 28 December 2026 by 05:30 PM.
